3. Materials 

3.1 Cannula— Seamless, drawn tuba having O'BOjnm wall thickness, made of stainless steel conforming 
to Designation 04Cr19Ni9, 06Cr18Ni1 1 Mo3 or 05Cr18Ni1 1 Mo3TI20 of Schedule V of IS : 1570-1961 
* Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes'; or brass tube having 0*5 mm wall 
thickness, conforming to IS: 407-1966 'Specification for brass tubes for general purposes 
( second revision ) \ 

3.2 Hub*- free cutting brass rod or bar, conforming to IS: 31 9-1 968 'Specification for free- cutting 
braes rods and sections (second revision) '. 

3.3 StUette — Hard-drawn brass wire or stainless steel wire- 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The surfaces of the curette shell be free from pits, dents, burrs, scales and other defects. 

4.2 Stllette, supplied one for each curette, shall be smooth, bright and free from kinks and shall slide 
smoothly into the cannula. 

43 The notch(es) shell be well formed and sharp. 

44 The closed tip of the working end shall be hemispherical. 
43 The soldering shall be neat and sound. 

4.6 The stainless steel cennule shall be passivated and polished bright. 

4.7 The brass parts shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating shall conform to Service 
Grade No. 2 of IS: 4827-1 968 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on 
copper and copper alloys '. 

6. Conical Fitting — Luer type, in accordance with IS: 3234-1 965 'Specification for conical fitting 
for hypodermic syringes, needles and other medical equipment, Luer type '. 

6. Testa 

6.1 Clamp the curette In a vice at the middle of the straight portion with its axis horizontal and working 
emflnclining upwards and in a vertical plane. Suspend a load of 20N (2 kgf approximately) gradually 
on the working end. On completion of the test the curette shall show no sign of damage. 

jfcl Corrosion Resistance Test ( for Stainless Steel Only ) — Test the sample In accordance with 
IS : 7631-1976 ' Method for boiling and autoclavlng test for corrosion resistance' of stainless steel 
surgical Instruments '. The sample shall show no sign of corrosion after the test." 

7. Marking — The curette shsll be marked with the manufacturer's name Initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

7*1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Packing-— The curettes shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bags, 
avoiding contact with one another.
